animate.description: Animate layout changes and focus transitions. Keep this off while troubleshooting layout behavior.

animation_duration.description: Animation duration in seconds when `animate` is enabled. Must not be negative.

animation_fps.description: Target animation frame rate. Higher values look smoother but use more CPU. Must be greater than zero.

animation_easing.description: Curve used to accelerate and decelerate animations.

default_disable.description: Start each newly encountered macOS Space inactive. Press your activation key before Rift manages it.

mouse_follows_focus.description: Allow Rift to move the pointer with keyboard-driven focus and workspace changes.

mouse_hides_on_focus.description: Hide the pointer after Rift changes the focused window. Rift also hides it after a pointer warp when `mouse_follows_focus` is enabled.

focus_follows_mouse.description: Ask Rift to focus a managed window when the pointer moves over it.

focus_follows_mouse_disable_hotkey.description: Optional hotkey held to temporarily suspend focus-follows-mouse. Use a full hotkey such as `Ctrl + A` or a modifier such as `Ctrl`.

auto_focus_blacklist.description: Bundle identifiers that should not cause Rift to switch workspaces when those applications become active, such as Spotlight.

window_insertion_point.description: Where Rift inserts a newly managed window. A layout-specific value wins; if neither value is set, Rift uses `next_to_selection`.

mode.description: Layout used for a workspace that does not match a `virtual_workspaces.workspace_rules` entry.

window_insertion_point.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for Traditional. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

equalize_nodes.description: Give a new window the average share of its siblings when inserting it. When false, split the selected window’s share instead. Manual resizing remains available.

traditional.description: Options specific to the Traditional tree layout.

window_insertion_point.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for BSP. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

bsp.description: Options specific to the BSP layout. Shared layout settings can still be set here.

window_insertion_point.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for Stack. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

stack_offset.description: Number of pixels by which each window is offset from the previous window in a stack. Must not be negative.

default_orientation.description: Direction of a new stack. `perpendicular` uses the axis across its parent, `same` uses the parent's axis, and `horizontal` or `vertical` forces an axis.

stack.description: Options specific to the Stack layout.

window_insertion_point.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for Master-stack. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

master_ratio.description: Fraction of the tiling area reserved for the master side. Valid range: `0.05` through `0.95`.

master_count.description: Number of windows kept on the master side. Must be at least `1`.

master_side.description: Edge occupied by the master side: `left`, `right`, `top`, or `bottom`.

new_window_placement.description: Where to insert a new window after the master area is full. `master` puts it in the main area and moves an existing window to the stack; `stack` keeps it in the supporting area; `focused` uses the focused area. Rift maintains `master_count`.

master_arrangement.description: Optional direction used to divide multiple windows inside the master side. When omitted, Rift uses the direction perpendicular to the master/stack split.

stack_arrangement.description: Optional direction used to divide windows inside the stack side. When omitted, Rift uses the direction perpendicular to the master/stack split.

master_stack.description: Options specific to the Master-stack layout.

top.description: Gap at the top of the screen

left.description: Gap at the left of the screen

bottom.description: Gap at the bottom of the screen

right.description: Gap at the right of the screen

outer.description: Insets between the tiled area and each edge of the display. Gap values must not be negative.

inner.description: Space between neighboring tiled windows. Gap values must not be negative.

top.description: Gap at the top of the screen

left.description: Gap at the left of the screen

bottom.description: Gap at the bottom of the screen

right.description: Gap at the right of the screen

outer.description: Override outer gaps completely for the display

inner.description: Override inner gaps completely for the display

per_display.description: Optional display-specific gap overrides keyed by display UUID. An override replaces the complete outer or inner gap group for that display.

gaps.description: Space between tiled windows and the screen edges, plus space between neighboring windows.

window_insertion_point.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for Scrolling. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

animate.description: Override animation only for Scrolling workspaces. Leave it unset to inherit `settings.animate`.

column_width_ratio.description: Normal width of a column as a fraction of the tiling area. It must stay between `min_column_width_ratio` and `max_column_width_ratio`.

min_column_width_ratio.description: Smallest column width allowed by resize commands, from `0.0` through `1.0`.

max_column_width_ratio.description: Largest column width allowed by resize commands, from `0.0` through `1.0`.

alignment.description: Position used when aligning the focused column: left edge, center, or right edge. `focus_navigation_style` determines when that alignment is applied.

focus_navigation_style.description: Choose how horizontal focus reveals a column. `niri` scrolls only as needed in the navigation direction; `anchored` always places the focused column at the chosen `alignment`.

enabled.description: Enable horizontal swipes for moving between columns in a Scrolling workspace.

invert_horizontal.description: Reverse the meaning of left and right column swipes.

vertical_tolerance.description: Allowed vertical finger movement while recognizing the start of a column scroll. Measured in trackpad coordinates: `0.4` and `40` both mean 40% of the trackpad height.

fingers.description: Number of fingers required for a column swipe.

distance_pct.description: Accumulated horizontal finger travel before Rift sends a scroll update, measured in trackpad coordinates. Smaller values send updates more often. Rift clamps the value to `0.01`–`1.0`.

propagate_to_workspace_swipe.description: After reaching the end of the column strip, continue the gesture into the adjacent virtual workspace.

workspace_switch_threshold.description: Overscroll, in normalized steps, required before the gesture switches workspaces.

gestures.description: Optional horizontal gestures for moving between columns in a Scrolling workspace. The finger count is configurable.

scrolling.description: Options specific to the Scrolling layout.

layout.description: Choose the default layout and set options shared by every layout. A layout-specific table can override a shared option.

enabled.description: Enable the menu bar workspace indicator.

show_empty.description: Include workspaces that currently have no windows.

mode.description: Show every workspace or only the active one.

active_label.description: Label a workspace with its one-based workspace number or its configured name.

display_style.description: Draw a miniature representation of each workspace’s windows (`layout`) or show a number or name (`label`).

layout_folder.description: Folder containing saved `.ron` layouts shown in the menu bar’s restore menus. `~` expands to your home directory.

menu_bar.description: Show workspace status in the macOS menu bar.

hover.description: Choose whether the indicator responds to a click or pointer hover.

thickness.description: Thickness of the stack-line indicator in points.

horiz_placement.description: Place the stack line at the top or bottom edge of the window.

vert_placement.description: Place the stack line at the left or right edge of the window.

spacing.description: Distance from the window edge to the indicator, in macOS points.

stack_line.description: Show a small edge indicator for stacked windows.

fade_enabled.description: Fade managed windows during Mission Control transitions.

mission_control.description: Rift’s own Mission Control-style workspace overview.

ui.description: Optional visual indicators. All UI helpers are disabled by default.

enabled.description: Enable horizontal trackpad swipes for switching virtual workspaces.

consume_dock_swipe.description: Prevent macOS or the foreground app from also handling a swipe Rift consumed.

invert_horizontal_swipe.description: Reverse the meaning of left and right swipes.

swipe_vertical_tolerance.description: Allowed vertical finger travel, measured in trackpad coordinates. `0.4` and `40` both mean 40% of the trackpad height; smaller values require a straighter swipe.

skip_empty.description: Skip workspaces with no windows when swiping.

fingers.description: Number of fingers required for a workspace swipe.

distance_pct.description: Horizontal finger travel needed to switch workspaces, measured in trackpad coordinates. `0.08` is roughly 8% of the trackpad width. Rift clamps the value to `0.01`–`1.0`.

haptics_enabled.description: Provide a tactile pulse when a workspace swipe is recognized.

haptic_pattern.description: Pattern of tactile feedback used for workspace swipes.

gestures.description: Optional horizontal gestures for switching virtual workspaces. The finger count is configurable.

drag_swap_fraction.description: Overlap needed to select a drag-swap target. Rift divides the intersection area by the union area of the two windows. Lower values make swaps easier to trigger.

window_snapping.description: Mouse-drag behavior for swapping tiled windows.

run_on_start.description: Command lines to run once Rift starts. Rift splits quoted arguments and launches the executable directly; use `sh -c` explicitly when shell syntax is required.

hot_reload.description: Reload the config file when it changes. Even when this is false, Rift watches for keymap changes and reloads when the parsed bindings differ.

keys.description: Hotkey strings mapped to Rift commands.

default_workspace_count.description: Number of virtual workspaces to create by default. Must be at least 1 and no more than 128.

workspace_auto_back_and_forth.description: Switching to the workspace you are already on returns to the previously active workspace.

prevent_wrapping.description: Stop at the first and last workspace instead of wrapping around.

workspace_names.description: Names for workspaces in index order. Names make app and workspace rules easier to read; the list cannot be longer than `default_workspace_count`.

default_workspace.description: Zero-based workspace selected when a new macOS Space is first managed. It must be less than `default_workspace_count`.

reapply_app_rules_on_title_change.description: Re-check title-based app rules when a window title changes. Useful for apps that finish naming a window after launch, but it can move a window again later.

app_id.description: Application bundle ID, matched without regard to letter case. For example, `com.apple.Terminal`.

workspace.description: Destination workspace name or zero-based index. Omit it to use the active workspace. Use a name from `workspace_names`.

floating.description: Keep matching windows outside the tiled layout. A winning rule with this field omitted uses `false`; actions are not inherited from other rules.

x.description: Horizontal position: `0.0` is the left edge and `1.0` is the right edge.

y.description: Vertical position: `0.0` is the top edge and `1.0` is the bottom edge.

position.description: Initial normalized position for a floating window. Both `x` and `y` are between `0.0` and `1.0`; position is only valid when `floating = true`.

w.description: Initial width in logical pixels. Must be positive when provided.

h.description: Initial height in logical pixels. Must be positive when provided.

size.description: Initial size in logical pixels. Set `w`, `h`, or both; this is applied once when the rule matches.

focus.description: Focus the window after applying this rule, switching virtual workspaces if needed.

manage.description: Set `false` to exclude matching windows from Rift. Set `true` to override the normal manageability checks for visible windows. Omit it to keep the normal checks. With `false`, omit placement and focus actions because they are ignored.

app_name.description: Case-insensitive containment match against the app name. Rift matches when the rule contains the app name or the app name contains the rule. Prefer `app_id` for an exact application match.

title_regex.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the window title. Use `title_substring` when you do not need a pattern.

title_substring.description: Case-insensitive text matched anywhere in the window title.

ax_role.description: Exact macOS Accessibility role, such as `AXWindow`. Useful when an app creates several kinds of windows.

ax_subrole.description: Exact macOS Accessibility subrole, such as `AXDialog`, to distinguish dialogs from normal windows.

app_rules.description: One rule per `[[virtual_workspaces.app_rules]]` entry. Match fields are combined with AND; the most specific matching rule wins.

workspace.description: Workspace name or zero-based index to match.

layout.description: Layout to use in the matching workspace.

workspace_rules.description: Rules that select a layout for a workspace by name or zero-based index.
